import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/cyclehire_w000.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)

# 1. Compute Departures and Self-Contained Trips
departures = df['departures'].sum()
self_contained_trips = df['self_contained_trips'].sum()

# 2. Calculate Arrival Share
arrival_share = df['arrivals'].sum() / departures if departures > 0 else 0

# 3. Compute Expected Self-Contained Trips
expected_self_contained_trips = df['arrivals'].sum() * arrival_share

# 4. Calculate Self-Containment Index
self_containment_index = self_contained_trips / expected_self_contained_trips if expected_self_contained_trips > 0 else 0

# 5. Perform Spatial Autocorrelation Analysis (Moran's I)
import libpysal
from esda import Moran

# Load the adjacency matrix
adjacency_matrix = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)
w = libpysal.weights.Rook.from_dataframe(df)
moran = Moran(df['self_contained_trips'], w)

# Print all results
print('Departures:', departures)
print('Self-Contained Trips:', self_contained_trips)
print('Arrival Share:', arrival_share)
print('Expected Self-Contained Trips:', expected_self_contained_trips)
print('Self-Containment Index:', self_containment_index)
print('Moran\'s I:', moran.I)
print('Moran\'s I p-value:', moran.p_sim)
